reason: 学習工程そのものの高速化・省メモリ化が最終目的であり、現行サーベイではTraining側が凍結対象のため除外。 旧判定: 1. **Training Deep Nets with Sublinear Memory Cost** — `arXiv:1604.06174` ([paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1604.06174)). Checkpoint/recomputation trades runtime for activation storage, reducing memory from linear to sublinear in depth; tests include 1000-layer ResNet under 7 GB and LSTM memory reductions above 4×, with about 30% runtime overhead. Included as training-memory systems work.
title: Training Deep Nets with Sublinear Memory Cost
